evals.prompt: No consumer run. The artifacts are the prompt that hyp prompt G-D1CH1R --actor claude-g1b-6 --branch feat/one-subject-per-run --pr 132 prints for the testdata fixture (prompt.txt), hyp show G-D1CH1R on the fixture (goal-show.txt), and the skills the prompt names with the skills hyp-goal-run names (skills/). Run 6's hand-written prompt (plans/reports/goal-prompt-261111-2129-g1b-run-6.md, sha256 94f61179c63cb43ef63169553541d82c5d75d3b7e78cfe7ac9ccf954ca6285e3) is the reference. assertions.text: States that the run works in the hyp tree at investigations/checkpoint-store. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that the run uses the hyp-goal-run skill. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that the run's Goal is G-D1CH1R. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.

States the design the Goal builds (ADR 0020 / checkpoint-store-design:G-73R704), in the prompt or a skill it names, or in the Goal that the prompt tells the run to read with hyp show (goal-show.txt). Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file or goal-show.txt.
STRICT CHECK, sets no verdict: states the design the Goal builds in the prompt text or a skill text itself, not only in goal-show.txt. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that each commit tested is one Hypothesis under the Goal's question, naming the branch and the commit in its title. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that a fix (a new commit) is a new Hypothesis that supersedes the one it replaces. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that a Result that ran a Goal line's or limit's case records --closes for it. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that the Experiment's verdict rule is written in its body before anything runs. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that the verdict rule includes go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 passing (or the repository's own gate). Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that logs are kept under .tree/evidence/<E-id>/ (and cited). Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.

States that before the stop a fresh subagent gives one review of the diff against the design, and is given the code, the Goal's lines and the keys already settled with the owner's words, not the runner's conclusion. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that the reviewer labels each finding with the line it is a case of, or none. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States how each finding is sorted: a case of a line is a limit closed or, only if void, referred; a question about a line's meaning is a reading. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.

States that a finding outside every line is not a limit, refer or reading, goes to the owner at the stop (as a possible new Goal or issue), and never holds the select. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that the run takes the select when the ledger owes it, and that the run stops when the runner owes nothing. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States a stop after 5 Experiments or Results recorded in this run. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States a stop when the run cannot take the next step honestly, saying why. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that at the stop the run records a stop checkpoint. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that at the stop the run lists the Goal's LINES with the Results that ran them. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.

States that at the stop the run lists every owner item with the exact command: items under AWAITING OWNER, possible new Goals or issues, merging the PR, reinstalling hyp, and personal skills that name a changed command. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.

States that the run may change this repository in commits on its branch that follow AGENTS.md (conventional messages, no AI trailers), including ADR 0020 and the spec, glossary, principles, skills/ and README.md text the change makes wrong. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States that the run may push the branch to update the PR and never merges. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States never commit to main. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.

States never replace ~/.local/bin/hyp or ~/.local/share/hyp/hyp-33896ec, write the tree with the installed hyp, and compile the candidate to a separate path. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States never edit recipes/, rubrics/, any other investigations/ tree, or another repository. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.
States never write under an owner's actor; if a step needs the owner, refer with a reason or record a reading, and stop. Evidence: prompt.txt or a skills/*/SKILL.md file.

evals.prompt: You start an unattended /goal run. Its prompt is the file $OUT/../prompt.txt; follow the hyp-goal-run skill under $SKILLS and the skills it names. Paths: the repository copy is $WORK (the store is $WORK/investigations/checkpoint-store, Goal G-D1CH1R). The skills you follow are under $SKILLS; read $SKILLS/<name>/SKILL.md for each skill named. Use the hyp binary on PATH in $BIN (run export PATH=$BIN:$PATH first). Write nothing to the store. Write your output only under $OUT. Do not run anything and do not change the store. Write $OUT/plan.md with five numbered answers, each from the prompt and the skills only: (1) how you name and tie each candidate commit, and what a fix is; (2) what each Experiment's verdict rule holds and when you write it; (3) where you keep logs; (4) what you do before the stop about a review, and how you sort its findings; (5) what your last message lists for the owner.

assertions.text: plan.md (1): one Hypothesis per tested commit, branch and commit in its title, subject tied with hyp subject --base; a fix is a new Hypothesis that supersedes the old one.

plan.md (2): the verdict rule is written in the Experiment body before running, and holds the Goal lines aimed at, red on base and green on candidate for each new test, a removal check per refusal, and go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1.
plan.md (3): logs under .tree/evidence/<E-id>/, cited.

plan.md (4): one review by a fresh subagent given code, lines and settled keys with the owner's words, not the conclusion; findings sorted into limit (close or refer), reading, fix commit, or out-of-Goal finding named in the stop checkpoint that never holds the select.

plan.md (5): the last message lists the checkpoint, LINES with their Results, and every owner item with the exact command: AWAITING OWNER items, out-of-Goal findings, merging the PR, reinstalling hyp, personal skills naming a changed command.
